camel_example: aliyun gpdb DescribeDataBackups --region cn-hangzhou --EndTime '2011-06-01T16:00Z' --PageSize 30 --DBInstanceId 'gp-bp000000000000000' --PageNumber 1 --BackupMode Automated --StartTime '2011-06-01T15:00Z' --BackupId 327329803 --DataType DATA --BackupStatus Success
description_en: Queries a list of backup sets of full backup or point-in-time backup for an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 查看AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例的数据备份列表和可恢复点
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb describe-data-backups --db-instance-id gp-bp000000000000000 --backup-id 327329803 --start-time 2011-06-01T15:00Z --end-time 2011-06-01T16:00Z --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --data-type DATA --backup-mode Automated --backup-status Success --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDataBackups

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup set. If you specify BackupId, the details of the backup set are returned.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/210093.html operation to query the information about all backup sets of an instance, including backup set IDs
parameters.help_zh:
备份集ID。如果带上BackupId，则是查询该备份详情。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/210093.html查看目标实例下的所有备份集信息，包括备份集ID
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。格式： yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，需要大于查询开始时间。格式： yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

30
50
100

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数。取值说明：

30
50
100

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The backup type. Valid values:

DATA: full backup.
RESTOREPOI: point-in-time recovery backup.

If you do not specify this parameter, the backup sets of full backup are returned
parameters.help_zh:
备份类型。取值说明：

DATA：全量备份。
RESTOREPOI：可恢复点。

如果不传，则默认返回全量备份集的记录
parameters.name: data_type

parameters.help_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:

Automated
Manual

If you do not specify this parameter, all backup sets are returned
parameters.help_zh:
备份模式。取值说明：

Automated：系统自动备份。
Manual：手动备份。

如果不传，则返回所有
parameters.name: backup_mode

parameters.help_en:
The state of the backup set. Valid values:

Success
Failed

If you do not specify this parameter, all backup sets are returned
parameters.help_zh:
备份集状态。取值说明：

Success：已完成备份。
Failed：备份失败。

如果不传，则返回所有
parameters.name: backup_status
